title: ExplorerUsage
responsibility: Shows up to three distinct revision-scoped consumers in one flat Used In footer with linked previews.

inputs.name: ExplorerUsage.consumers
inputs.description: Referenced consumers at the shown revision, or empty for a dash.

inputs.name: ExplorerUsage.nav
inputs.description: Navigation preserving the selected branch and commit.

inputs.name: ExplorerUsage.lens
inputs.description: The selected revision evidence resolver; no screenshot is borrowed from another entity.

inputs.name: ExplorerUsage.mediaBase
inputs.description: URL prefix resolving the referenced screenshot file.

inputs.name: ExplorerUsage.layout
inputs.description: Optional compatibility input. Defaults to JavaScript undefined. Its value is ignored: every footer remains a flat list.

inputs.name: ExplorerUsage.limit
inputs.description: Optional lower limit; every footer shows at most three distinct consumers. A zero limit shows the hidden-consumer count; positive limits use an accessible overflow ellipsis.

outputs.name: ExplorerUsage
outputs.description: One flat Used In list in provided consumer order, capped at three distinct links; overflow has an accessible ellipsis, or a visible hidden-consumer count when the limit is zero.

errors.name: nav.href callback error
errors.description: An error from the address callback propagates while rendering a consumer link.

errors.name: nav.go callback error
errors.description: An error from the navigation callback propagates when a consumer link is activated.

errors.name: nav.source callback error
errors.description: An error from the source-opening callback propagates when a consumer's source button is activated.

errors.name: lens.evidence callback error
errors.description: An error from the evidence callback propagates when a visual consumer preview opens.
